_note: Batch C and B strings. MERGE THIS INTO foundry/static/lang/en.json (same nesting) and delete this file; it is not loaded at runtime. WOF.Prompt.* is the prompt card's own chrome (src/dice/card.ts, prompt.ts); WOF.Tracker.* are the tracker's lines (src/tracker/*.ts).

Prompt.waitNote: Waiting on {n} roll(s). The GM can roll any of them.
Prompt.dueNote: Waiting on {n} roll(s). Unanswered ones roll themselves when the timeout runs out.
Prompt.noResolver: This system cannot resolve that prompt.

prompt.steamDeath: {name} ({label}) dies, and the steam scalds everyone On Body or at its Blind Spot.
prompt.steamRegen: {name} ({label}) fills its Regeneration clock, and the steam scalds everyone On Body.
prompt.steamRolls: a D6 on the steam table
prompt.injuryCause: {name} is at 0 Health: the injury is {type}.
prompt.gasCause: The round ends, and everyone who used their ODM Gear owes a Gas Roll.
prompt.flightCause: {name} moves relative to {label}, {from} to {to}, on their ODM Gear.
prompt.flightGone: {name} is no longer where the move began: nothing moved.

harm.steamNone: Nobody is caught by the steam.
harm.steamAsked: The steam scalds {who}: each rolls their own D6.
harm.fallAsked: {name} takes a {band} fall: their own D6.

result.injuryAsked: {name} is asked for their Critical Injury dice.

note.flightAskedLine: Relative to {label}, to {to}: their own client rolls the Fly.
note.retargeted: It cannot reach its holder, so it turns on {name} for {entry}.

end.gasAsked: Gas Rolls owed by {who}: each rolls their own.

move.forceGM: Only the GM steps over the rules.

gm.onlyGM: Only the GM can do that.
gm.undone: The GM's ruling was taken back.
gm.loudCleared: {name} is no longer the loudest to {label}
gm.spent: {name} has spent their move this round

promptTimeout.name: Prompt timeout
promptTimeout.hint: Prompt cards (steam, falls, Critical Injuries, Gas Rolls, Flights) wait for the player by default. Set a number of seconds to have unanswered prompts roll themselves; 0 waits. The GM can always roll a prompt for a player.
